papers.title: 20 reasons why geoengineering may be a bad idea
papers.finding: Catalogues physical, ethical and governance risks of stratospheric aerosol injection, including monsoon disruption, ozone loss and termination shock.

papers.title: A temporary, moderate and responsive scenario for solar geoengineering
papers.finding: Proposes a bounded deployment framing intended to reduce, not replace, mitigation and to limit risks such as termination shock.

papers.title: The Geoengineering Model Intercomparison Project (GeoMIP)
papers.finding: Establishes a standardized set of climate-model experiments enabling consistent comparison of SRM impacts across earth system models.

papers.title: Reflecting Sunlight: Recommendations for Solar Geoengineering Research and Research Governance
authors: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
papers.finding: Recommends a cautious, transparent and governed US research program on solar geoengineering with strong oversight and exit ramps.
